Method of Attack: Phishing kit mimicking legitimate login workflows to steal credentials and payment information
Collects victim data including email, password, Cash App PIN, full name, address, Social Security Number, payment card details, and identification documents
Uses emails and SMS messages with fraudulent security alerts to lure victims
Employs antibot and anti-crawling defenses to evade detection
Configurable phishing URL and data exfiltration parameters
Attack Vector: Phishing emails and SMS messages with fraudulent security alerts and links
